messages:
serena: Hey team — PR #8952 is ready but blocked on architecture signoff. This touches routing policy + kv-cache invalidation; need an arch check before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8952 RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/arch-routing-8952

devon: pinging @linus and @maria — low-latency route change. main concern is graceful fallback and SLO delta.

linus: I can take a look this afternoon. quick q: do we need a new fallback model variant or can we reuse the existing small-model fallback (gpt-small-v2)?

serena: prefer reuse if safe — fallback should be immediate when capacity thresholds hit. also want a short canary (25% for 2h) and an automatic rollback trigger on 5% error increase.

maria: noted. infra tests currently flaky around shard-splitting; please include a test plan and explicit smoke steps in the RFC before I approve. also need the SLO delta spelled out (p50/p95 change).

serena: adding test matrix + SLO delta to RFC now, will paste a link when updated. short summary in the PR description too.

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: CI passed on feature branch (linux/amd64). Canary schedule placeholder: 2024-11-12T09:00:00Z @ 25% if merged.

linus: if arch can't sign off today, suggestion: merge behind feature-flag + implement enforced fallback to gpt-small-v2 in routing layer as a temporary safety net. that lets apps opt-in later.

devon: fine as a contingency but prefer formal arch ack. @maria can you validate fallback path once serena updates the RFC?

maria: yes, I'll run smoke and a shard-split test tomorrow morning and post results here. will check kv-cache invalidation path too.

serena: thanks — for reviewers, the specific change is in the RFC section "Routing policy & fallback". short diff pasted below:

```diff
@@ -120,6 +120,14 @@
 routing.policy = "balanced"
+// fallback: route to gpt-small-v2 when available capacity < 10%
+if (capacityPercent < 10) {
+  route.to = "gpt-small-v2"
+  route.metadata.reason = "capacity_pressure"
+}
+// canary: 25% traffic, 2h window

```

linus: LGTM pending the test matrix and SLO numbers in the RFC. I'll post a quick inline comment on the PR for a tiny doc tweak.

serena: added SLO delta + test checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/arch-routing-8952#test-plan. thanks all, will wait for final ack or opt for feature-flag merge if needed by EOD.
